description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the EmployeeTimesheetAPI class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It tests creating, retrieving, updating, and handling exceptions for employee timesheet API endpoints.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetAPITest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeTimesheetAPI, testing create, get all, update, get one, and delete operations, along with exception handling.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of a timesheet entry through the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the create operation.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all timesheet entries.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for the get all operation.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the update operation.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the getOne method which is expected to throw a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Tests validation rules for getOne method, expected to throw a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests the delete method, expected to throw a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests validation rules for delete method, expected to throw a 'not implemented' exception.
